Dead Mind Flayer can be found in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

Involvement

Act One

The dead mind flayer can be encountered in the Shattered Sanctum during  Dror Ragzlin's questioning. If Ragzlin is killed before he casts  Speak with Dead on the corpse, the party can instead question the mind flayer. Upon casting the spell, the player character immediately recognises the mind flayer as responsible for abducting them and implanting their parasite.

Speak with Dead

The dead mind flayer can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Tell me who the Absolute is.
    • Dead Mind Flayer
      Fractured images fill your mind: curved drow blades, crude goblin torches, gnoll teeth dripping blood. You see other mind flayers arranged in a serene circle. Absolute unity. Absolute power.
      • What does the Absolute want from the goblins?
        • Dead Mind Flayer
          You see Dror Ragzlin writhe. A tadpole clings to the mind flayer's fingers. The goblin king bows, obedient. The flesh of his tribe becomes the flesh of the Absolute.
  • Why did you abduct me?
    • Dead Mind Flayer
      Dark, empty pods flicker across your vision. They demand new flesh.
  • How do I get rid of this parasite?
    • Dead Mind Flayer
      You see the tadpole in the mind flayer's hand. Not a parasite: perfection. Rebirth is sloughing flesh. A new skull housing cold, sharp intellect.
  • Why did the dragon-riders attack the ship?
    • Dead Mind Flayer
      You watch through the creature's eyes as it curses the star-born slaves. They want the ones from the ship. Darkness and sun, barely contained.
  • Are there more of your kind nearby?
    • Dead Mind Flayer
      You see dark tunnels lit by noxious pools of brine. The darkness spreads through the earth. The sky splits open, and nautiloids pour out of a void that consumes the stars.
